div.head: Introduction
div.p: Background on the topic of marine policy and the institutions that implement it across regions.

div.head: Background
div.p: Nested background on earlier treaties, regional fisheries bodies, and the gap this paper addresses in monitoring.

div.head: Methods
div.p: We surveyed twelve sites using structured interviews and coding. Each site received the same protocol, blinded coders, and inter-rater checks before analysis.

div.head: Results
div.p: Most sites showed improvement after the protocol was applied, with measurable gains in reporting completeness.

div.head: Conclusion
div.p: Marine policy should adopt stronger monitoring frameworks soon. Future work must tie enforcement data to measurable ecological outcomes across exclusive economic zones.
